name: nortura-power-bi-agentic

owner.name: Replace with your name or team

description: Layered Power BI / Fabric agentic development stack. Layer 1 (harness, process) is client-agnostic and reusable across engagements. Layer 2 (nortura-design) is Nortura-specific. Depends on the community power-bi-agentic-development marketplace for underlying PBIP/DAX/Fabric technical skills.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Reusable safety harness: data-classification and workspace-tier policy engine, PBI/Fabric routing table, and enforcement hooks. Client-agnostic — reads its registry from the target project's .claude-governance/ folder, not from this plugin.

plugins.name: process
plugins.description: Reusable human-in-the-loop development process for Power BI / Fabric work: plan, branch, hook-validate, screenshot-review, PR review, staged deploy. Client-agnostic.

plugins.name: nortura-design
plugins.description: Nortura-specific Power BI report design system: approved layouts, theme, backgrounds, and visual placement rules.

plugins.name: nortura-semantic-standards
plugins.description: Nortura-specific semantic model conventions: naming, documentation, and house Best Practice Analyzer rules. Contains generic placeholder defaults pending Nortura's confirmed standard.
